newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, buyers, sellers in stand-off.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, buyers, sellers in stand-off.

text.p: Naphtha was steady to a touch firmer on Tuesday amid a continued stand-off between buyers and sellers.
"There was loose talk of $193-194 cif so the market is probably around $192," said one dealer of cargoes in NWE.
Only a little trader interest was seen with most end-users firmly sticking to the sidelines in anticipation of lower prices.
August swaps of $190-191.00 and a widening backwardation of $3.50 into September has encouraged a "wait and see," policy on behalf of end-users, traders said.
With arbing out of the region no longer possible the wet market continues to retain a listless, drifting tone.
